chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad ibn Isa and Ibn Abi Umayr, from Muawiya ibn Ammar, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)

Regarding the Words of Allah, Mighty and Majestic: 'Allah will certainly try you with some game which your hands and your lances can reach.' He (peace be upon him) said: 'The wild animals were gathered for the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) during the Umrah of Al-Hudaybiyya to the extent that their hands and their spears could reach them.'
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of the 'game' mentioned in Surah Al-Ma'idah verse 94 according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi offers a specific historical exegesis for Quran 5:94, identifying the 'game' as wild animals gathered during the Umrah of Al-Hudayyyah to test the Prophet and his companions. It highlights the practical application of hunting prohibitions in a state of Ihram, emphasizing the divine trial inherent in maintaining ritual purity amidst natural opportunities.
